en: Something that is not correct; or to think someone or something is a different person or thing.
ex: I made a mistake in my math test.
我在數學考試中犯了一個錯。

en: Of the present or recent times; using the newest methods or ideas.
ex: The hospital has the most modern equipment.
這家醫院擁有最現代化的設備。

en: A very short period of time; or a particular point in time.
ex: Wait a moment; I will be right back.
等一下，我馬上回來。

en: What you use to buy things, in the form of coins and notes or in a bank account.
ex: I don't have enough money to buy the new bike.
我的錢不夠買這輛新腳踏車。

en: An animal with long arms and a tail that climbs trees; or to play around and tease.
ex: The monkey climbed up the tree to get the banana.
猴子爬上樹去拿香蕉。

en: One of the twelve periods of time into which the year is divided.
ex: My birthday is next month.
我的生日在下個月。

en: The large round object that shines in the sky at night and goes around the Earth.
ex: The moon was bright last night.
昨晚月亮很亮。

en: A greater amount or number of something; or to a greater degree.
ex: Could I have some more tea, please?
請再給我一點茶好嗎？

en: The early part of the day, from sunrise to noon.
ex: I get up at six o'clock every morning.
我每天早上六點起床。

en: The greatest in amount or number; or nearly all; or very.
ex: Most students walk to school in the morning.
大多數學生早上走路上學。

en: A woman who has a child; or to care for someone like a mother.
ex: My mother cooks dinner every evening.
我媽媽每天晚上做晚餐。

en: A very high hill, often with snow at the top.
ex: We climbed the mountain on Saturday.
我們星期六去爬山。

en: A small furry animal with a long tail; or a small device you move to control a computer.
ex: The cat chased a mouse across the kitchen.
貓追著一隻老鼠跑過廚房。

en: The opening in your face that you use to eat and speak; or the opening of something such as a river or cave.
ex: Don't talk with your mouth full.
別嘴裡塞滿食物說話。

en: To change position or place; or to change where you live; or an action or a change of position.
ex: They are going to move to a new city next month.
他們下個月要搬到一座新城市。

en: A story shown in moving pictures on a screen, usually with sound.
ex: We watched a funny movie last night.
昨晚我們看了一部搞笑電影。

en: A title used before a man's name.
ex: Mr. Wang is our English teacher.
王先生是我們的英語老師。

en: A title used before the name of a married woman.
ex: Mrs. Lee is the principal of our school.
李太太是我們學校的校長。

en: A title used before a woman's name, whether she is married or not.
ex: Ms. Chang will be our new manager.
張女士將成為我們的新經理。

en: A large amount of something; used with uncountable nouns; or very.
ex: I don't have much time to talk now.
我現在沒有太多時間聊天。

en: Wet, soft earth that sticks to things.
ex: The children came home covered in mud.
孩子們渾身是泥地回到家。

en: A building where interesting and valuable objects are kept and shown to the public.
ex: We visited the museum on our school trip.
我們在校外教學時參觀了博物館。

en: Sounds made by instruments or voices in a pleasing way.
ex: She likes listening to music while she studies.
她喜歡邊念書邊聽音樂。

en: Used to say that something is necessary or very important to do; or to say that something is very likely.
ex: You must wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
騎腳踏車時你必須戴安全帽。

en: The word or words that people use to call a person or thing; or to give something a name.
ex: My name is Anna, and what's yours?
我叫安娜，你呢？

en: Relating to a whole country; or belonging to a country.
ex: October tenth is a national holiday in Taiwan.
十月十日是台灣的國定假日。

en: All the plants, animals and things in the world that are not made by people; or a person's basic character.
ex: I enjoy walking in nature at the weekend.
我週末喜歡在大自然中散步。

en: Not far away in distance or time; or to come close to something.
ex: Is there a bank near here?
這附近有銀行嗎？

en: The part of the body that connects your head to your shoulders; or the part of a piece of clothing around the neck.
ex: The giraffe has a very long neck.
長頸鹿的脖子很長。

en: To require something because it is necessary; or a situation in which you must have something.
ex: I need to buy a new pair of shoes.
我需要買一雙新鞋。

en: A material made of crossed threads or wires with spaces in between; or the internet; or the amount left after costs.
ex: The fisherman threw a net into the sea.
漁夫把一張網撒進海裡。

en: At no time; not on any occasion.
ex: I have never been to Japan before.
我以前從未去過日本。

en: Recently made or discovered; not old; or different from before.
ex: She bought a new dress for the party.
她為了派對買了一件新洋裝。

en: Reports of recent events in the paper, on TV or on the internet; or new information.
ex: I heard the news on the radio this morning.
我今天早上從廣播聽到了這個消息。

en: Large sheets of folded paper printed with news that you can buy every day.
ex: My father reads the newspaper every morning.
我爸爸每天早上看報紙。

en: Coming immediately after the present one; or at the time after now.
ex: The next train leaves in ten minutes.
下一班火車十分鐘後開。

en: Pleasant, friendly or enjoyable; or well done.
ex: It is nice to see you again.
很高興再見到你。

en: The part of the day when it is dark and most people sleep.
ex: I go to bed at ten o'clock every night.
我每晚十點上床睡覺。

en: Used to say that something is not true or not allowed; or not any.
ex: No, thank you. I don't want any more.
不用了，謝謝。我不想再要了。

en: Not any person; no one.
ex: Nobody was at home when I arrived.
我到的時候，家裡沒有人。
